title: English Practice Quiz 0961
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: When a disagreement begins at work, the best first step is to ___.
questions.explanation: Listening helps identify the actual issue before deciding what to do.

questions.question: A compromise is an agreement in which each side ___.
options: accepts part of what it wants

questions.question: Which phrase helps calm a tense discussion?
questions.explanation: Calm language can reduce tension and keep attention on the issue.

questions.question: If a disagreement cannot be resolved between colleagues, they may need to ___.
options: seek help from a supervisor or mediator
questions.explanation: A neutral person may help the parties reach a fair solution.

questions.question: To clarify a misunderstanding, you should ___.
options: explain what you meant and invite questions
questions.explanation: Clarifying meaning gives both people a chance to understand.

questions.question: A neutral mediator should ___.
questions.explanation: A mediator helps discussion without taking sides.

questions.question: Which statement focuses on the problem rather than attacking a person?
options: The report is missing two required details.
questions.explanation: It identifies a specific issue without making a personal accusation.

questions.question: The phrase 'reach an agreement' means to ___.
questions.explanation: The parties arrive at a decision they accept.

questions.question: When emotions are high, taking a short pause can help people ___.
questions.explanation: A brief pause can help people regain composure.

questions.question: After resolving a workplace conflict, it is useful to ___.
options: confirm the agreed actions and responsibilities
hide the decision from everyone affected
questions.explanation: Recording agreed actions helps prevent the same misunderstanding.
